relevance_note: Case report of a PSTPIP1 variant carrier with Hz/Hc: "the c.748G>A variant (Glu250Lys) was found in heterozygosis in the exon 1 of the PSTPIP1 gene"; Table 1 also gives individual-level data for 8 previously reported Hz/Hc patients.
method_note: Read the whole paper; a Python script in the scratch directory built the JSON and transcribed Table 1 (patients as columns; header row '|  | Previous reports x8 | Current report |'); its output was checked against the table. Table 1 columns 1-8 ('Previous reports') are previously published Hz/Hc patients, labelled 'Table 1 column k'; column 9 ('Current report') is the case-report patient, labelled 'patient' (rule 5) and not given a separate row. Table 1's title cites references '1, 3, 4' for the table as a whole with no per-column reference, so source_reference_in_review is 'not reported' for columns 1-8 (the citation is not person-specific). No PSTPIP1 variant is printed or tied to the Table 1 literature patients, so they have no variant rows; they are in scope by their Hz/Hc diagnosis. Table 1 'Age at diagnosis' has no unit; ISO values use years from Table 2's 'Age at diagnosis (years)'. '–' cells in Table 1 are not defined in the legend and are recorded as not reported; 'No' skin lesions (columns 3, 4) is recorded as excluded skin lesions and used to exclude the checklist items pyoderma gangrenosum, acne and hidradenitis suppurativa (not the composite skin or soft-tissue abscesses). 'Normal' growth (columns 5, 6) excludes growth failure. CRP, zinc and calprotectin values in Table 1 above the printed reference ranges in the row headers were recorded as elevated. Hemoglobin values were not converted to anemia for columns 1-8 because no reference range is printed (Table 2 gives anemia 5/6 only as a count). Patient: thrombocytopenia was marked observed from 'pancytopenia'; neutropenia left not reported (pancytopenia does not specify neutrophils). Abdominal pain and diarrhea recorded as features, but inflammatory bowel disease/colitis left not reported. Arthritis from Table 1 column 9 ('Arthritis') plus knee joint pain with edema and erythema. Inconsistency noted: the text gives zinc 869 μg/L and calprotectin 642 μg/L for the patient, while Table 1 column 9 gives zinc 138 (μm/L) and calprotectin 0.6 (g/L); both are above their stated reference ranges, so no status contradiction. Pathogenicity is the authors' citation of database classifications, recorded verbatim. Variant type 'missense' rests on the authors' description of an amino-acid substitution. Study-level references to Hz/Hc being caused by PSTPIP1 mutation (Introduction, Discussion) were not used for any person.
